Package neqsim.thermo.util.steam

Class SeawaterProperties

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.util.steam.SeawaterProperties
public final class SeawaterProperties extends Object
Industrial seawater properties from IAPWS-IF97 liquid water plus the IAPWS-08 saline Gibbs energy.

The saline coefficients are Table 2 of IAPWS R13-08 (2008), reproduced with attribution to the International Association for the Properties of Water and Steam. Using IF97 for the water contribution follows the industrial approach in IAPWS Advisory Note 5 (2016 revision) and Kretzschmar et al. (2015), doi:10.1080/19443994.2014.925838. This is not the IAPWS-95-based TEOS-10 model. Salinity is Reference-Composition Salinity in g/kg of solution, not practical salinity or salt per kg of water. The implemented cooling envelope is 273.15-353 K, 1-120 bara and 0-120 g/kg. Pressure derivatives outside the oceanographic range (T at most 313 K and S at most 42 g/kg) are extrapolations; inspect isWithinPressureReferenceRange(double, double) before using density or acoustic results.

      temperature - temperature [K]
